care.sequin: Dry clean only. Store folded in a soft cotton or muslin bag; do not hang, iron directly on the sequins or wring.
care.brocade: Dry clean only. Iron on the reverse at low heat with a pressing cloth. Store folded away from damp and direct sunlight.
care.silk: Dry clean only. Iron on the reverse at low heat. Store folded in a muslin cloth, away from damp and direct sunlight.
care.lace: Dry clean only. Iron on the reverse at low heat with a pressing cloth; do not iron the sequin trim. Store folded.

products.name: Black & Gold Damask Sweetheart Blouse
products.short: Black sweetheart-neck blouse with a gold damask brocade waistband and back.
products.description: A classic black sweetheart blouse lifted with rich gold damask brocade: the motif runs along the waistband, up the straps and across the back, finished with fine gold piping at the neckline. Sleeveless with broad straps, a deep V back and a hook-and-eye closure. Pairs beautifully with black, gold or jewel-toned sarees.

products.name: Noir Floral Embroidered Bustier Blouse
products.short: Black bustier blouse with tonal floral thread embroidery, sequins and thin straps.
products.description: An evening bustier in black, covered in tonal floral thread embroidery scattered with tiny sequins that catch the light. A straight, gently curved neckline sits on slim spaghetti straps, with a clean low back and hook-and-eye closure. Effortless with a sheer black or metallic saree.

products.name: Black Sequin Sweetheart Tie-Back Blouse

products.name: Silver Lattice Sequin Tie-Back Blouse

products.name: Black Sequin Scoop-Neck Blouse

products.name: Black Sequin Plunge V Blouse
products.short: Black sequin blouse with a plunging V neckline and a shaped underbust seam.

products.name: Black Sequin Deep-V Blouse

products.name: Black & Silver Quatrefoil Tie-Back Blouse

products.name: Rani Pink Floral Brocade Blouse

products.description: Delicate ivory lace cut in a sweetheart neckline, with a silver sequin trim tracing the neckline and straps. A deep U back with hook-and-eye closure completes it. A soft, bridal-feel blouse for ivory, blush and pastel sarees.

products.short: Black and silver striped sequin blouse with a sheer mesh yoke and crystal lines.

products.name: Black Paillette Sweetheart Blouse
products.short: Black blouse in large glossy paillettes with a sweetheart neck and broad straps.
